name: Irish Road Trip with Miriam Margolyes
original_name: Irish Road Trip with Miriam Margolyes
overview: Presented by Miriam Margoyles, this arts documentary series shines a new light on Lady Augusta Gregory, the brilliant, driven and complex woman whose work, influence and impact on Irish political and literary life has often been neglected in favour of those who she brought together around her dinner table and who drank her cellar dry.
